falsification_binding.binding: FAMILY kill evaluated at R1/R5: if NO placed arm of the family clears its committed per-leg worst-case round-trip cost ceiling after the FULL measured path-cost ladder at the primary stress tier (Q-16 component and forced-rebalance multiplier included) -- equivalently every A4-P2 arm's after-cost expectancy on the primary NET book is at or below zero -- the family is KILLED and recorded as VOL_NG1_REJECT_ALL evidence. No threshold moves after any scored number.

VOLNG1-A5-P2.c8_limitation_travels_with_every_artifac: STRUCTURAL LIMITATION (declared, C8): the realized proxy is the realized volatility of the event-adjusted VXX close.  An ETP-leg realized vol is NOT S&P 500 realized vol -- it is implied-complex realized vol: a leveraged, fee-bearing VIX-futures-complex instrument whose realized path embeds roll and decay.  The implied-vs-realized state computed from it is an implied-vs-implied-complex proxy, never the classic implied-vs-spot-realized variance risk premium.

falsification_binding.binding: FAMILY kill evaluated at R2: if the asymmetry placement is NOT DISTINCT from its own single-segment marginals (collapses into a bucket placement within the frozen ancestry margin of either marginal or of the lane's sibling spread-state form), the family is killed as NON-NOVEL and recorded as VOL_NG1_REJECT_ALL evidence. Distinctness is the claim; its absence is the kill.
